**Current projects**

[Sierra Pass Watch](https://d1ffq2igwl7mzc.cloudfront.net/) | [Repo](https://github.com/mariekarpinska/sierra-pass-watch) -  traces your planned Sierra Nevada drive, pulls the live forecast from departure time, and matches it to historical crashes under the same weather conditions per mile of route. Built with React + TypeScript, FastAPI, and Postgres.

[World Cup Bracket](https://worldcup-bracket-9wbf.onrender.com/) - A tiny invite-only web app where my friends/family and I predict the 2026 World Cup knockout bracket and compete on a leaderboard. Built serverless on AWS's free tier (Lambda, DynamoDB, Cognito) to run at $0/month, with a scheduled job that auto-texts the current standings to our group chat every morning.

[Buildska](https://buildska.com) - Software engineering practice. Database migrations, website rebuilds, and agents for small businesses.
